A's heavy geometric sans with an italic serif ampersand has strong personality and slightly crisper hierarchy, but it reads more generic-modern than warm. | pass 2 (A=with, B=without): A pairs a characterful serif for the name and card titles with a clean sans for the one-liner and button.
